submitter: bugfix-19 session (bugfix_154 lane, follow-up to approved e64f8576)
rationale:
The shared save_page_sections refusal helper puts the completeness floor's sentence in the shrink guard's mouth. Observed live, not inferred: the first induced shrink refusal (2026-08-02 22:56Z, site_work_items ebc1dda8) reached the queue summarised as 'Page rebuild refused: "beginners" returned too few sections to replace what is stored' — FALSE for a shrink refusal, where every section came back and one was too small — and its fix text pointed the operator at prune_floor_ratio, the WRONG config key (the shrink guard's escape hatch is section_shrink_floor). spec.reason carried the correct detail, but the summary and fix are what the queue shows, and an operator triaging them is sent to a count problem that does not exist. Nine council seats across the two e64f8576 rounds did not see this; watching the real item land did.

This is the SAME defect class the council approved the cure for on 2026-08-02 (prune-floor aftermath clause, one round, approved 09:46Z): a shared refusal helper with a fixed sentence that is true for one consumer and false for the others. The cure is the same by design: Summary and Fix become REQUIRED caller-supplied parameters — no defaults, so a future caller is asked the question by the compiler instead of silently inheriting an answer. The completeness floor's two call sites keep their existing sentences verbatim (zero operator-visible change); the shrink guard's two call sites (violation and measurement-error) each state their own case, and the shrink fix names section_shrink_floor.

WHAT DOES NOT CHANGE: ItemType and ItemKey stay shared ('save_refused_incomplete:<page>'), deliberately — one OPEN refusal per page is the dedup contract (idx_swi_dedup), whichever guard fired first, and the induction demonstrated that contract working. recurrenceExpected semantics are the emitter's and are untouched. No decision rule moves: this changes what the refusal SAYS, not what is refused — per the 2026-07-29 owner ruling that is normal-gate scope, and the identical prior change went through this gate on exactly that basis.

plan.summary: Make savePageSectionsRefusal's Summary and Fix required caller-supplied parameters so each of the four call sites (two completeness, two shrink) states its own true sentence; the shrink guard stops borrowing 'returned too few sections' and stops pointing operators at the wrong config key.

edits.rationale: The helper keeps routing (Source, Pipeline, ItemType, ItemKey, Subject) and gives up authorship of the prose. The completeness floor's sentences move to a named function + const beside it and are passed explicitly by its two call sites, byte-identical to today — the consumer for whom the old wording is TRUE keeps it verbatim, exactly as the aftermath-clause change kept 135's clause.

The shrink guard's own sentences: violation summary 'a prose section of %q shrank past the floor'; measurement-error summary says the guard could not measure; shrinkRefusalFix states nothing was written, names section_shrink_floor as the escape hatch (0 disables), and directs the operator at why the writer regenerated the whole section — the actual 178 question — with the reason field carrying slot and before/after sizes.
edits.sketch:
_ = emitPruneRefusalWorkItem(ctx, params.DB, savePageSectionsRefusal(siteID, pageID, pageName, reason,
	fmt.Sprintf("Page save refused: a prose section of %q shrank past the floor", pageName),
	shrinkRefusalFix), params.Logger)

const shrinkRefusalFix = "A save would have shrunk a prose section past the configured floor, so NOTHING was written and the existing page still stands (bugs_open/178). Decide: if the shrink is intended, lower section_shrink_floor on the save_page_sections step (0 disables the guard); otherwise find why the writer regenerated the whole section instead of editing it — the reason field names the slot and the exact before/after sizes."

edits.rationale: The NEGATIVE assertions are the load-bearing half — forbidding 'too few sections' and 'prune_floor_ratio' in the shrink refusal's Summary AND Fix — because asserting only the new wording would still pass if the borrowed sentence were concatenated alongside it (the aftermath round's lesson, reused). Also asserts the fix names sectionShrinkFloorKey and that ItemType/ItemKey keep the shared dedup contract. Mutation-proven from a fresh git-archive baseline: re-inserting 'returned too few sections' into shrinkRefusalFix fails exactly this test, naming the forbidden string; restore re-verified green, full package green.

grounded_in: THE FALSE SENTENCE, OBSERVED IN THE QUEUE: site_work_items ebc1dda8 (2026-08-02 22:56:00Z, the induced shrink refusal) — summary column verbatim: 'Page rebuild refused: "beginners" returned too few sections to replace what is stored'. The refusing guard's actual finding, from the same row's spec.reason: 'article-body 15443→4644 chars (30% kept, floor 50%)' — all sections present, one too small.

THE WRONG REMEDY KEY: the emitted Fix text tells the operator to 'lower prune_floor_ratio on the save_page_sections step' — the completeness floor's key; the shrink guard reads section_shrink_floor (save_sections_shrink_guard.go, sectionShrinkFloorKey). An operator following the emitted instruction would tune a floor that has nothing to do with the refusal.

THE PRECEDENT, SAME CLASS SAME CURE, ALREADY APPROVED BY THIS COUNCIL: 2026-08-02 09:46Z, one round — the prune-floor refusal's aftermath clause was made a required caller-supplied parameter because a fixed sentence true for one consumer (135's skip-the-prune) was false for the other three (whole-operation refusals). This submission applies the identical design to the identical shape one helper further down: required parameters, the true-for-it consumer keeps its wording verbatim, empty inheritance made unrepresentable.

CALL-SITE COUNT MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED: grep -rn 'savePageSectionsRefusal(' over non-test actions returns exactly four call sites — save_sections_prune_floor.go:206,241 (completeness) and save_sections_shrink_guard.go:148,181 (shrink). All four are updated in this change, so the signature is compile-enforced and no caller can be left on the old prose.

THE DEDUP CONTRACT IS PROVEN, NOT ASSUMED, AND PRESERVED: the 2026-08-02 induction produced two refusals 2m34s apart and exactly ONE open work item (idx_swi_dedup collapsed the second emit). ItemType/ItemKey are deliberately untouched, and the new test pins them.

MUTATION EVIDENCE, RUN FROM A FRESH ARCHIVE BASELINE: M1 re-inserting 'returned too few sections' into shrinkRefusalFix → TestShrinkRefusalDoesNotBorrowTheCompletenessSentence FAILS, its message quoting the forbidden string in the mutated fix text. Restore verified, targeted tests and full package green (verified against git archive HEAD + these three files; the in-tree build is currently broken by another session's unrelated in-flight edit).
plan.risks:
WORDING-ONLY ON THE WIRE: no decision rule, threshold, item_type, item_key, status, severity or recurrence semantics change; consumers that key on item_type/item_key (dedup, queue views, the 165-round two-strike handling) see identical rows apart from the two text columns. The completeness floor's emitted text is byte-identical to today, so no operator-facing sentence changes except the two that were false.

SIGNATURE CHANGE ACROSS FOUR CALL SITES in two files, both this lane's. Compile-enforced — a missed caller cannot build — and verified against git archive HEAD because the shared working tree currently carries another session's broken in-flight edit (their file, untouched here).

SUMMARY LENGTH: the emitter truncates summaries at 250 chars; both new summaries are ~70 chars, well inside.

A REVIEWER SHOULD CHECK: that the shrink guard's measurement-error path deserves the shrink Fix text rather than a bespoke transient-error sentence — chosen here because its aftermath (nothing written, existing page stands) and its escape hatch (section_shrink_floor) are the same, and the reason field already says the measurement failed.
